rule: No process-global mutable state in gwz-cli: it is the driver, which captures its arguments, working directory and environment at startup and passes them to core (GwzCoreSessionDesign O9, §11). This list is the complete inventory of production exceptions. gwz-core's check_process_globals.py, run by scripts/test_process_globals.py in this repository's CI, fails on anything unlisted and on entries that no longer match, so the list only shrinks; the same run fails on production code in a crate's tests/ directory. 'debt', 'permanent', 'owner' and 'imposed_by' mean what the rule of gwz-core's scripts/checks/process_globals_allowlist.json says (GwzCoreSessionCrateMap §1, 'No globals'). Here a 'permanent' entry names in 'imposed_by' what forces it, except immutable data, which that rule admits as it is.

entries.name: env::var
entries.reason: The diff renderer picks its pager as `git diff` does, for byte and text output. Presentation in the CLI's own process, never sent to core; the pager stays in the CLI when the diff path moves to the session (session plan CS6.2).

entries.name: Command::new
entries.imposed_by: the user's command: gwz forall runs it in each member, in the user's environment
entries.reason: forall is CLI-local (GWZDesign's CLI driver design; session plan CS6.3, D3). Its children are the user's programs, run from argv or through the platform shell, so they are spawned without env_clear().

entries.name: VALUE
entries.reason: Immutable data: the --build-info text, formatted once from compile-time constants (a cache of immutable data, GwzCoreSessionCrateMap §1).

entries.name: Command::new("help")
entries.imposed_by: clap: its builder type is named Command
entries.reason: Not a process: clap::Command::new("help") defines the help subcommand. The lexical scan reads every Command::new as a spawn.

entries.name: env::var_os
entries.imposed_by: the platform's home directory: HOME, or USERPROFILE on Windows
entries.reason: The Claude Code hook finds the user's Claude settings and its own user log under the home directory, one read per platform module. The hook's probes stay in the CLI (session plan CS6.2).

entries.name: Command::new("cp")
entries.imposed_by: the platform's copy tool: std has no reflink copy
entries.reason: `cp -c` (macOS) or `cp --reflink=always` probes whether a block-sharing copy works on the lane's filesystem (D6). A hook probe, which stays in the CLI (session plan CS6.2).

entries.name: Command::new("df")
entries.imposed_by: the platform's df: std has no free-space query
entries.reason: `df -Pk` measures free space and the device under the lane's destination (D6, D11). A hook probe, which stays in the CLI (session plan CS6.2).

entries.name: Command::new("fsutil")
entries.imposed_by: Windows' fsutil: std has no free-space query
entries.reason: `fsutil volume diskfree` measures free space on Windows (D11). A hook probe, which stays in the CLI (session plan CS6.2).

entries.name: Command::new("mount")
entries.imposed_by: the platform's mount table: std has no filesystem-type query
entries.reason: Names the destination's filesystem type where BSD stat cannot, as on macOS (D6). A hook probe, which stays in the CLI (session plan CS6.2).

entries.name: Command::new("stat")
entries.imposed_by: GNU stat: std has no filesystem-type query
entries.reason: `stat -f -c %T` names the destination's filesystem type (D6). A hook probe, which stays in the CLI (session plan CS6.2).

entries.name: Command::new("git")
entries.imposed_by: Claude Code's WorktreeCreate hook: outside a GWZ workspace the hook stands in for its git worktree add
entries.reason: D8's fallback in a plain repository, where no gwz-core semantic applies. Deliberate, and outside the no-fallback plan (gwz-core dev-docs/GwzNoFallbackPlan.md §1, GwzLibgit2Gaps.md §4).

entries.name: env::var_os
entries.imposed_by: Claude Code: it gives hooks the session's project root only as CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR
entries.reason: The hook's project root, falling back to the invocation directory when run by hand (S1.1).

entries.name: env::args_os
entries.imposed_by: the process interface: a command-line program receives its request as its arguments
entries.reason: run() reads the arguments once at startup: the --build-info check, then the clap parse. Part of the driver's startup capture (GwzCoreSessionDesign §11).

entries.name: env::current_dir
entries.imposed_by: the process interface: the caller's directory is the process working directory
entries.reason: Read once at startup and sent in every request as the caller's directory; core never reads the process directory (gwz-cli 49d784d).

entries.name: env::var_os
entries.imposed_by: less: LESS is its option variable
entries.reason: Sets LESS=FRX for the pager child only when the user has not set LESS.

entries.name: Command::new("cmd")
entries.imposed_by: the user's pager command line ($GIT_PAGER or $PAGER), which only the platform shell runs as written
entries.reason: Windows: the pager runs through cmd /C and inherits the terminal and the user's environment.

entries.name: Command::new("sh")
entries.imposed_by: the user's pager command line ($GIT_PAGER or $PAGER), which only the platform shell runs as written
entries.reason: Unix: the pager runs through sh -c and inherits the terminal and the user's environment.

entries.name: env::var
entries.owner: CS6.1 (proposed: the session plan names no step for these reads)
entries.reason: gwz's own GWZ_URL_SCHEME, read at the point of use: when the request is built, and again when the summary names the scheme's source. No dependency imposes it. It belongs with the environment the session driver captures at startup (GwzCoreSessionDesign §11).

entries.name: env::vars_os
entries.imposed_by: CLI process entry: capture the command environment once (GwzTransportOffSwitchDesign §2; GwzCoreSessionDesign §11)
entries.reason: One immutable EnvironmentSnapshot is passed to the resolver before backend creation; no core policy reads the process environment and no mutable process-global state is introduced.
